clinical_intent: A center is validating its treatment planning system dose calculation for a ring applicator. The TG-43 based calculation at 1 cm from the ring center gives 8.5 Gy/min. An independent calculation using a spreadsheet-based TG-43 algorithm gives 8.3 Gy/min. Calculate the percentage discrepancy between the two calculations and evaluate whether it falls within the TG-59 recommended tolerance of 5% for independent dose verification.
